units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣家所遣送的，是现任摄津守兼左京大夫惟光朝臣的女儿。

en.t: The girl sent by the household of Genji, the Grand Minister, was the daughter of Koremitsu Ason, who was currently serving as Governor of Settsu and Senior Assistant Minister of the Left Capital Office.

units.source_text: 这女儿相貌生得极好，有美人之名。

en.t: This daughter was exceptionally beautiful and had a reputation as a great beauty.

units.source_text: 惟光觉得身份不配，有些为难。

en.t: Koremitsu felt that her rank was not suitable and was somewhat troubled by it.

units.source_text: 旁人却指责他说：“按察大纳言所遣送的竟是侧室所生的女儿，你把嫡妻所生的爱女送出去，有什么难为情呢？”

en.t: Others, however, reproached him, saying, "The daughter sent by the Inspector Grand Counselor was even born of a concubine. If you send your beloved daughter born of your principal wife, what is there to be embarrassed about?"
After hearing this, Koremitsu still hesitated and could not make up his mind.

units.source_text: 但念当过舞姬之后便可在宫中充当女官，便打定了主意。

en.t: But when he considered that after serving as a dancer she could become a court lady in the palace, he made up his mind.

units.source_text: 先叫她在家里练习舞蹈。

en.t: First he had her practice dancing at home.
Her attending maids were all chosen with great care.

units.source_text: 到了规定那天傍晚，便把女儿送进二条院去。

en.t: On the evening of the appointed day, he sent his daughter into the Nijo residence.

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣也把各院中的女童和侍女都叫出来，仔细观察选择，指定若干人作舞姬的随从。

en.t: Genji, the Grand Minister, also summoned the young girls and maids from all the residences, examined and selected them carefully, and appointed several to serve as attendants to the dancer.

units.source_text: 入选的人，想到自己的身份，无不感到荣幸。

en.t: Those who were chosen, considering their own status, all felt deeply honored.

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣规定：在皇上御前表演之前，先在他自己面前试演一次。

en.t: Genji, the Grand Minister, decided that before they performed before the emperor, they would first give a trial performance in front of him.

units.source_text: 他看见所选定的童女，容貌姿态个个十分优美，因为人数过多，欲除去几个，竟舍不得割爱。

en.t: When he saw the young girls who had been selected, each one graceful in both face and bearing, he wanted to remove a few because there were too many, but he could not bear to part with any of them.

units.source_text: 他笑着说：“我想再遣送一个舞姬才好呢。”

en.t: He said with a smile, "I wish I could send one more dancer."

units.source_text: 终于只得根据她们的仪态和神情而复选了一次。

en.t: In the end, he had no choice but to make another selection based on their bearing and expressions.
